meaning:
A woman of the Egyptians living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.11.19; married to Pharaoh (H6547K);
mother of: daughter_of_Pharaoh (H6547P)
§ Tahpenes = "wife of the king"
an Egyptian queen in the times of David and Solomon

elsewhere.note: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
